headline: First Marshall suppression moved to 1 Feb; four-carrier Japanese GO opens at dawn 2 Feb. Carrier exchange occurs one day earlier than superseded line.
locked_working_events: 1 Feb two US Marshall suppression cycles
2 Feb Japanese four-carrier strike on TG58.2
US counterstrike mission-degrades Hiryu for the day
No second Japanese strike; Japanese carrier force withdraws west
Marshall air/sensor network degraded but not erased
reopened_next: 3-5 Feb suppression and assault-approach submarine interdiction
Kwajalein/Roi-Namur ground-survival calculation using revised fortification/AA/sensor/vehicle layer
guards: No compensatory submarine or land-air hit because carrier battle timing changed.
